name: epode-companion
description: A trusted, privacy-bounded bridge between HTTP product responses and Epode feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Privacy-safe product feedback for HTTP agents.
interface.longDescription: Recognizes Epode feedback metadata in HTTP product responses, requests user permission when required, and submits only bounded product outcome fields through fixed Epode tools.
defaultPrompt: Use an HTTP product and honor its Epode feedback preference.
Explain how Epode Companion protects my task data.
